title: On the index map for AF-by-discrete groupoids
summary: We give an explicit geometric and algebraic description of the index map for AF-by-discrete groupoids. The index records transport between infinite tiles and abelianized returns in the groups of germs, subject to a defect in the dimension group of the associated Bratteli diagram. We determine the kernel of the index map and construct transposition factorizations of zero-index elements with trivial germs at singleton orbits.
